// Package idlesim 是三工坊生产与放置收益的业务示例，不是公共框架内建经济规则。
package idlesim

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/configdata"
	"io"
)

var ErrRule = errors.New("idle sim: invalid identity, time, operation, inventory or limit")

const LedgerLimit = 128
const QueueLimit = 4
const ValueLimit int64 = 1000000
const DayMillis int64 = 86400000
const MaxTime int64 = 4000000000000

type Recipe struct{ Work, Raw, Output, Price int64 }
type Rules struct {
	Version                                                       string
	Recipes                                                       [3]Recipe
	OfflineCap, TickMillis, IncomePeriod, PendingCap, BoostMillis int64
	WarehouseCap, RawCap                                          int64
}

func DemoRules() Rules {
	return Rules{Version: "idle-v1", Recipes: [3]Recipe{{10000, 2, 2, 3}, {20000, 3, 1, 8}, {40000, 5, 1, 15}}, OfflineCap: 30000, TickMillis: 1000, IncomePeriod: 10000, PendingCap: 100, BoostMillis: 10000, WarehouseCap: 20, RawCap: 100}
}
func (r Rules) Validate() error {
	if r.Version == "" || len(r.Version) > 64 || r.OfflineCap < 1000 || r.OfflineCap > DayMillis || r.TickMillis < 100 || r.TickMillis > r.OfflineCap || r.IncomePeriod < 100 || r.IncomePeriod > DayMillis || r.PendingCap < 1 || r.PendingCap > 10000 || r.BoostMillis < 100 || r.BoostMillis > DayMillis || r.WarehouseCap < 3 || r.WarehouseCap > 1000 || r.RawCap < 50 || r.RawCap > 1000 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	for _, v := range r.Recipes {
		if v.Work < 100 || v.Work > DayMillis || v.Raw < 1 || v.Raw > 10 || v.Output < 1 || v.Output > 10 || v.Price < 1 || v.Price > 100 {
			return ErrRule
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (r Rules) Hash() string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(encode(r)))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func validTime(now int64) bool { return now > 0 && now < MaxTime }
func encode(v any) string {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(raw)
}
func strictJSON(raw string, out any) error {
	if len(raw) == 0 || len(raw) > 256*1024 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewBufferString(raw))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := d.Decode(out); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return nil
}
func OpenCatalog(dir string) (*configdata.Store, error) {
	r := configdata.NewRegistry()
	configdata.MustRegisterObject(r, configdata.ObjectDef[Rules]{Name: "idle_rules", File: "idle.json", Validate: func(_ *configdata.BuildContext, r Rules) error { return r.Validate() }})
	s := configdata.NewStore(r, dir)
	_, err := s.Load(context.Background())
	return s, err
}
func CaptureRules(s *configdata.Snapshot) (Rules, error) {
	r, ok := configdata.ObjectFrom[Rules](s, "idle_rules")
	if !ok {
		return Rules{}, ErrRule
	}
	return r, r.Validate()
}
